# Membervault

MemberVault is a Relationship Marketing Platform that allows users to host courses, memberships, and other digital products in one place.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/membervault/.

## Actions

- **Add User to Course**: Add a user to a specified product.
- **Delete User**: Completely delete a user from the account, including all data, progress, and quiz answers (irreversible).
- **Get Courses** (read-only): Retrieve all courses (products) in the membervault account.
